subject.title: Feature request: Session TTL / max lifetime for automatic rotation

question: Should OpenClaw add general max-age and max-turn automatic session rotation, and what config shape plus memory/continuity contract should it use?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix creates public lifecycle config and must define how automatic resets preserve memory, transcripts, delivery route, and provider-owned session state.

options.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
options.body: Extend session.reset with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory, transcript, route, provider-continuity, docs, and tests.

options.title: Fold into broader session boundaries
options.body: Keep this requirement open but implement it only as part of the broader session-boundary, pruning, and automatic split design across the related open issues.

options.title: Defer automatic rotation
options.body: Document cron, context-pruning, daily/idle reset, and manual reset mitigations while avoiding a new core lifecycle config surface for now.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in lifecycle policy
recommendation.body: Extend session.reset with maintainer-approved max-age and max-turn triggers plus explicit pre-rotation memory, transcript, route, provider-continuity, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal across daily reset and pre-compaction memory flush, which are central to the product boundary.
